Five lug nuts are visible in the recessed holes around the center. A portion of the black rubber tire is visible at the top edge. The background shows dark shadows within the wheel well.

The transition where the spokes meet the outer rim lip is slightly soft and lacks a crisp boundary, suggesting minor geometric bleeding, though not catastrophic.
